name: Fibra UNO
summary: Trust FIBRA UNO (“Fibra UNO”) was established as a real estate investment trust (Mexican REIT) on January 12, 2011 by Fibra UNO Administración, SA de CV, (the “Trustor”) and Deutsche Bank México, SA, Institución de Banca Múltiple, División Fiduciaria y Subsidiarias (“Deutsche Bank México”) as Trustee Institution. Fibra UNO began operations in March 2011, and it was mainly incorporated to purchase and own real estate properties in order to lease and develop commercial, industrial and mixed-use properties, as well as office buildings and lands in the Mexican Real Estate Market.
